claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.current_item_kind
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Several passive and reaction riders apply only in specific weapon forms, so held-item state alone is not precise enough.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase item attachment for magic-item self-transforms
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item can change its own form, but the current activation surface has no honest way to target the held item for alter_item_kind.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_weapon_profile
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Quarterstaff form gains the Thrown property and explicit normal/long ranges, which is neither a passive numeric modifier nor an existing item-kind swap.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: return_weapon_after_ranged_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The weapon returns deterministically after a ranged attack, which needs a post-attack return mechanic not present in the current atom surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand."
